pr_title: Add beatmap panel to multiplayer match screen
pr_comments:
I'm pretty happy with this. I had to refactor MBP a little bit because I encountered 2 issues:
1. The drawable is disposed when the TestScene is removed and `LoadComponentAsync` throws an exception in that case. This is resolved by `Schedule()`ing the request callback.
2. Multiple drawables could potentially be added at the same time since the async-load callback wasn't cancelled. This is resolved by using a cancellation token.

@peppy wanna go through a final pass after my refactorings?

issue_context.title: Quick download button in multiplayer room
issue_context.body: It would be useful to have a quick download button in multiplayer room instead of opening the beatmap overlay just to download the beatmap.
comments:
> It would be useful to have a quick download button in multiplayer room instead of opening the beatmap overlay just to download the beatmap.

I would suggest that it takes the overlay download button with yellow colour.

This can be solved by showing a beatmap card on the multiplayer screen (same design as osu!direct). The "View Beatmap" button can be removed as a result.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/62671762-126ecc80-b9d3-11e9-905f-9c5e7f3564ae.png)

Has been confirmed with @arflyte.
